_comment: Factory default delivery-team configuration. scaffold-new-project.sh copies this to a project's .factory-roles.json; the launcher's new-project wizard (scripts/factory.sh) overrides tool and name per role from the detected CLIs. Supported tools: claude, cursor, codex, gemini. Role keys are structural and must not be renamed — the custom 'name' is the display/prompt label. See docs/adr/0013-configurable-roles-and-tools.md.
